entries.summary: Phase 2 完成了 saveFullProject 级联删除保护修复。在 project.repository.ts 的 saveFullProject 事务中，增加了 executions 备份（cascade delete 前 SELECT）和恢复（tasks 重建后 INSERT with onConflictDoNothing）逻辑。修复了执行记录因 ON DELETE CASCADE 链被永久删除的根本原因。

metadata.plan_id: 修复执行记录丢失问题

lessons_learned: test_engineer scope 声明需包含测试文件路径，否则 test_engineer 无法写入测试文件
saveFullProject 的 backup/restore 模式比修改 CASCADE 约束更安全，因为不需要 schema migration
PGlite 集成测试是验证数据库事务逻辑的最佳方式，mock 无法测试真实的 CASCADE 行为
项目 ESLint 配置从 .eslintrc.json 迁移到 eslint.config.js 仍然是未解决的技术债务

entries.summary: Phase 2 完成了执行状态变更审计日志系统。创建了 execution_status_history 表（Drizzle schema + PGlite 建表 SQL）、ExecutionStatusHistoryRepository（create + findByExecutionId），并在 execution-registry 的 4 个状态转换点（pending→running, running→completed, running→failed, running→cancelled/timed_out）集成了 fire-and-forget 审计日志。server restart 的 cleanup 场景因执行上下文丢失而跳过审计。

metadata.plan_id: AI 执行生命周期监控

lessons_learned: Task 2.1 was falsely marked completed from a previous session (checkpoint restore cleared code but not gate evidence) — always verify actual file existence before trusting task status
test_engineer scope declaration must include the test output file path exactly; directory mismatches cause write authorization failures
Fire-and-forget audit logging pattern (Promise.catch) is ideal for non-critical side effects that must never block the main execution flow
PGlite integration tests are more reliable than mock-based tests in bun:test due to vi.mock() chaining limitations in bun
